summary: Revision 2 resolves DP-01: the owned desktop adapter explicitly uses named preload operations, skips browser pairing/bearer creation, and preserves browser regression coverage. DP-02 is substantially resolved by a required exact-artifact packaged E2E target covering IPC, navigation, privileges, preview isolation and failure lifecycle/child reaping. One prior requirement remains absent from the exact command contract: packaged renderer bundle inspection. Full F-01–18 product scope remains active; this increment is correctly described as a synthetic desktop shell milestone only.

open_findings.title: Bind packaged renderer bundle inspection to a required check
open_findings.evidence: Plan step 5 and completion criteria require packaged bundle inspection, and ADR-0002 explicitly requires inspecting the packaged renderer bundle for Node built-ins, secrets, bridge-only code and unsafe APIs. However, desktop-packaged-e2e scope lists runtime privilege/preview inspection and lifecycle assertions without bundle inspection; desktop-build only builds/hashes, and boundaries remains workbench-web:boundaries. No required command scope currently owns this remaining DP-02 obligation.
open_findings.impact: The required command scopes can pass without inspecting the delivered renderer assets. Runtime privilege absence does not establish that forbidden authority, bridge-only code or secrets were excluded from the packaged renderer bundle.
open_findings.required_correction: Add packaged renderer bundle inspection for Node built-ins, secrets, bridge-only code and unsafe APIs explicitly to desktop-packaged-e2e scope (or a separate required packaged inspection check), bound to D-2 and D-3 and the same delivered artifact SHA-256. The existing exact-artifact E2E command can own this; no new user approval or wider product scope is needed.

resolved_findings.resolution: Plan lines 21–22 specify readSyntheticSnapshot/onBridgeStatus through owned utility/main/preload, desktop-only adapter selection, no pairing or bearer creation, explicit startup/unavailable/quit/restart states; line 37 owns the affected renderer/shared API paths. Packaged E2E explicitly verifies the transport path and browser regression coverage remains required.
